review.shorterRoute: Apply the existing original centered-global-cover theorem to the image of the finite marked cover set. Within a lifted radial carrier, exact projection and injective original coordinates give injectivity and transfer the source center. Thus base marked separation suffices even if several cover marks project to the same place. Reuse the existing endpoint-range incidence proof and native radial-center interior theorem.

No marked-dissection or separation premise remains.
